$comment: Known-incomplete shipped token sets, per GATED coverage dimension, with the reason each one
is not fixed yet. Read by scripts/audit-token-sets.mjs --check and by
tests/vitest/tokenSetCoverage.spec.js, so the CLI and the gate cannot disagree.
This file is a ratchet and it has to be able to fail every way: the gate fails on a set below
the bar that is not listed here, on a listed set that has started passing (delete the entry),
on an entry under a dimension nothing gates, and on a reason shorter than 20 characters. An
allow-list without reasons is how a baseline becomes permanent.
THE COUNT WENT 42 -> 34 WITHOUT ANY SET IMPROVING, and that is the one movement this file has
to explain rather than absorb. The `bridge` dimension was demoted from a bar to reported-only
on 2026-10-04, which deleted its 8 entries (amsterdam, denhaag, epe, groningen, ridderkerk, rijkshuisstijl, utrecht, zwolle).
The measurement that forced the demotion is under $reported.bridge below. Demoting a dimension
is the only edit that lowers this count with nothing fixed, so the audit refuses a demotion
that is not written down there.
Baseline recorded 2026-10-04: font 0, logo 34. Gated dimensions: font, logo, contrast.

$reported.bridge: Measured and published, deliberately NOT gated. css/systems/nldesign/utrecht-bridge.css holds 84 declarations shaped --nldesign-component-X: var(--utrecht-Y, <fallback>); outside comments, 42 fall back to a var(--nldesign-*) token the SET declares, 38 to a non-colour literal (1rem, 1px, 0.5rem, 700, transparent, underline), 3 to a colour literal (#e5e5e5 and #696969 for the disabled button, #ffffff for the textbox fill) and 1 to another var(). Resolved over the real cascade, amsterdam and rijkshuisstijl are both bridge-zero and differ on 32 of the 84 component tokens, with Amsterdam's buttons at #004699 and Rijkshuisstijl's at #154273. So a bridge-zero set adopts the NL Design System's component geometry and type scale and still brands the component colours from its own semantic layer: a working theme, not a broken one. Gating it withheld 8 working sets from the admin picker. The figure stays in the report because a set with its own --utrecht-* layer owns its radii, spacing and type scale, which is part of conformance to a house style.
